notes.title: CARROT CAKE RELEASE & MAJOR PATCH
notes.notes:
[h1]Happy Easter![/h1]
Carrot Cake is now available on Steam! I've been working on this game for months to get it released before Easter and It's finally here! Carrot Cake has had a rocky launch due to the rush and I appreciate all of the support and feedback the past couple of days.

[h2]Fixed Major Bugs[/h2]
I got a ton of feedback day 1 and I read all of it. [b]All feedback[/b] and bug reports push the game closer to how I envisioned it. The game launched with some major soft locks and game breaking bugs but I'm proud to say that [b]they have been fixed![/b] I'm still working on minor bugs and making the game more immersive but I'm happy with the progress we've already made.

Thank you all for the support and Happy Easter!
